packageDirectories.versionName: v3.3.0 — CMDT-generated prompt schema for supported wire keys
packageDirectories.versionDescription: Current 3.3.0.NEXT source for the Résumé Parser full app. It includes the bounded generic CMDT runtime: validated direct Resume_Data__c and Work_Experience__c fields become generic prompt, review, and commit envelopes; supported types, duplicate-target rejection, compatible picklists/defaults, and fail-closed disclosure are enforced. It also includes temporary Draft/file cleanup. The repository provides a separate exact-version Agent Script lifecycle under agent/, which is not included in the app package. This source is source-deployable and validated in enabled non-production orgs, but it is not yet a newly built/promoted package. 04tHu000004hhiJIAQ (3.2.1-1) remains the last BUILT/Released production-installable package and retains its older hardcoded extraction schema.
